verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services company with its own case-preparation platform. A SaaS service like this could plausibly publish an official MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint, and probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec (all 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
